items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: I've heard that, that Beiderbecke listened to Hardy quite a bit.

ctx.x: Would it be possible to ask, some have said that Emmet Hardy had a great deal of influence on Bix Beiderbecke? Do you remember Beiderbecke's playing in the game?
I've heard that, I've heard that. I've heard that, that Beiderbecke listened to Hardy quite a bit.
I don't know whether he'd be able to remember if there was any similarity in their playing. I consider it unlikely myself.
